row.name: Pop Culture Group Co. Ltd Class A Ordinary Shares

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=27 breakdowns=10 bursts_in_base=2 giveback=1.35 tightness=0.39 base_volume_vs_leg=0.08 base_volume_vs_avg=0.33
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 27 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 10 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.35 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -17.4% vs its 20-SMA, -31.4% over 20 sessions
gain of 18.85% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 18.5% in 8 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The chart tells the whole story immediately: CPOP spiked to ~$400 in early June then collapsed into a months-long downtrend that is still in progress, with price now near zero on the scale — this is not a consolidation base, it is a slow bleed from a blow-off top. The 'base' is 27 sessions of lower lows and lower highs with 10 four-percent breakdowns and a giveback of 1.35x the prior leg, which the checklist itself FAILs on C. A burst bar on a sub-$5 name that is 18.85% up (the worst event-study cell, 36% win rate) off a downtrending base with no prior trend to speak of is not a momentum burst setup.
claude.key_risk: The stock is in a persistent post-blow-off downtrend with no base structure; any follow-through is likely to be reversed within days as the downtrend reasserts.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of open — the base failure and downtrend context disqualify this setup before price action at tomorrow's open is even relevant.

row.summary: CPOP: +18.9% on 35.9× volume out of a base 61.6% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
